Items

[SR] EMU cancellations Sept 17 — 4 Tambaram–Beach EMUs fully cancelled (40040 Tambaram–Beach 11am; 40041 Beach–Tambaram 11:50am; 40050 Tambaram–Beach 1:50pm; 40051 Beach–Tambaram 1:25pm), "operational reasons"; 2 MEMUs (66045 Tambaram–Villupuram, 66046 return) partially cancelled between Villupuram–Tindivanam Sep 17–18 for Perani Yard line block (1–3pm). — DT Next, Sep 17. https://www.dtnext.in/news/chennai/emus-between-beach-tambaram-cancelled-on-september-17-and-18 (also TOI, Sep 16: https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/these-chennai-suburban-trains-wont-run-on-thursday/articleshow/134289742.cms)

  2. [CMRL] Arumbakkam 7-storey commercial complex — 17,872 sq ft plot behind Arumbakkam station; basement + stilt + 7 floors; 34,206 sq ft built-up (4 retail/food + 3 office floors); 4-tier mechanical parking; construction tender floated, ~2 years to build; part of Phase-II ~12 lakh sq ft commercial plan along Corridors 3–5. — PropNewsTime, Sep 17. https://propnewstime.com/latestnewsstories/MzY3NDA=/cmrl-plans-seven-storey-commercial-complex-at-arumbakkam-metro-station

  3. [CMRL] Metro sewer work → pumping stations shut — CMRL interconnection of major sewer pipeline on Ramakrishna Math Rd, Teynampet; stations Border Thottam, Ram Nagar, Arunachalam St, Ice House not operated 10pm Sep 18 – 2pm Sep 19 (16 hrs); Royapuram & Teynampet zones warned of sewage issues; Metrowater complaint lines 8144930905 / 8144930909. — The Hindu, Sep 16 (7:04 pm IST). https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/chennai/areas-under-royapuram-and-teynampet-zones-may-experience-sewage-issues-on-september-18-and-19/article71472189.ece

  4. [NHAI] Maduravoyal–ORR elevated: bids deferred 15 times — ₹1,228.87 cr tender floated Aug 18, 2025; opening now Oct 16, 2026; stalled on financial sanction, not bid quality; 8.14 km six-lane, eventual double-decker with CMRL Poonamallee–Sunguvarchatram metro above; ~97,304 vehicles/day near Maduravoyal. — DT Next, Sep 17 (G Jagannath). https://www.dtnext.in/news/chennai/maduravoyal-outer-ring-road-tender-bids-deferred-15-times
